export.render: upstream renderFrames: native fps, default options/seed, actor false, bg none
export.pixelCopy: Unmodified straight-alpha RGBA from renderFrames.clear; no canvas alpha-premultiplication
export.frames: Every native sample including final frame for one-shots; one period for loops
export.timing: Native fps; frame duration rounded to 6 decimal milliseconds, no speed changes in asset
export.playback: once; UI may scale playback duration independently
